experiment: R2-B1 IMAX milestone 1: imaginary-axis true displacement vs real-axis control vs QAOA p=L at B* (development only)
approval: User approved Nov 9 19:10 Shanghai: 'Yes, test D(i alpha) alongside the real displacement at the entropy-peak fields.' D2-D5 approved simulation definitions (Nov 9 18:41). Not a hardware-feasibility result.
written: before any IMAX fit; after conformance tests tests_imax.py all pass
circuit: |+>^N -> [UcZ -> trueD(axis*alpha_l)^{xC} -> bareS_l^{xC}]^L ; axis in {i (IMAX), 1 (real control)} fixed per arm; UcZ shared across layers, A = gamma[J + thK Khat + thM Mhat]; alpha_l real, one per layer, shared by cavities; 3 shell SNAP phases per layer shared by cavities; no axis-angle or complex-amplitude parameter
encoding: binary Fock 0..7, bit r of f <-> site a + r*N/3 (interleaved), as LE

offcode.D3: Uz primary (pair terms touching a leaked cavity off), U0 sensitivity arm
offcode.D4: per-term H_ext: |J_ij| per pair touching a leaked cavity, +b per leaked qubit
offcode.D5: ideal logical readout (exact-energy mode; W_L cost unmodelled, counted in accounting only)

fields: B* only: per-instance refined argmax of S_A(b) of the exact GS, A = sites 0..floor(N/2)-1 (user-confirmed to match local); grid [0.02, 3.0] x 75 then bounded refinement xatol 1e-6; hard checks: interior argmax, interior refinement, unique + Perron-positive GS, GS flip-even, residual < 1e-9. An instance failing a hard check is reported and excluded (no replacement in M1).
N_stage2_rule: run N=12 after N=6,9 complete with tests passing; no N>=15 in M1
budget: inclusive: every energy query (calibration, perturbations, candidates) is counted by core.Budget; no monitoring, no uncounted initial or restart energy calls; selection = lowest counted candidate energy
cutoff_certification: at EVERY leaky selected point (both caps): |dE|, |dF|, |dp_leak| between nf_fit and 48 <= 1e-8, and |norm-1| <= 1e-10 at nf_fit and 48; any violation flags the run uncertified (reported, not silently used)

spsa.per_start: 4 two-sided calibration estimates (8 queries) + 2K perturbation queries + 2 candidates (last, Polyak last 64)

init.nov9_random: gamma~U(-.5,.5), theta~U(-.5,.5)^2, |alpha_l|~U(.02,.08) x common random sign x alternating pattern, s~U(-.3,.3)
init.note: identical init for IM and RE arms; alpha pattern is initialization only

IM_U0.label: IMAX true D(i alpha), U0 extension sensitivity

IM_B.label: IMAX strict-logical D8 diagnostic, NOT true D

rng: SeedSequence([seed, N, 0, L, method_id, start, stream]); stream 0 SPSA Delta, 2 init (the b slot is 0 = B*)
report: F unconditioned (exact GS, post hoc only)
paired dF, dE IM-QAOA and IM-RE with bootstrap 95% CI of the mean (10000 resamples, rng 0) and win counts
F tails: min, 25th percentile, fraction F>=0.5
IM vs U0 at identical params
reading_rules: 8 seeds: descriptive, no target claim. Negative curvature at |+> is a prediction, not proof of success. Kill: IM median eta < 0.25 at N=9 L=1 cap 1024 -> IMAX fails its first gate. Leakage: IM_B good (eta>=0.5) but IM eta<0.25 -> leakage-limited. Extension: median |F_IM - F_IM@U0 same params| > 0.01 -> extension-dependent. Same-L advantage only if the paired IM-QAOA dF CI excludes 0 on the positive side.
not_run: real basin audit (FT stream B2 owns it)
